results.title: the exposure: a plain table (no RLS) reads for anon and authenticated
results.detail: anon GET sec21_pii -> 200, 2 rows; authenticated -> 200, 2 rows. Default grants make every public table readable by any key holder.

results.title: REVOKE from anon, authenticated (+ USAGE, + default privileges): tables closed, RPC still open via PUBLIC
results.detail: closed after 0s. anon table -> 401 42501: permission denied for table sec21_pii; authenticated table -> 403 42501: permission denied for table sec21_pii; service_role table -> 200, 2 rows. anon RPC -> 200 STILL CALLABLE - functions carry EXECUTE for PUBLIC (proacl {=X/postgres,postgres=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres}) and schema public keeps USAGE for PUBLIC (nspacl {pg_database_owner=UC/pg_database_owner,=U/pg_database_owner,postgres=U/pg_database_owner,service_role=U/pg_database_owner,sec17_backend=U/pg_database_owner,supabase_auth_admin=U/pg_database_owner,sec17_owner=UC/pg_database_owner}).

results.title: REVOKE EXECUTE from PUBLIC (+ default privileges): anon RPC closed, service_role RPC open
results.detail: after revoking EXECUTE from PUBLIC (closed after 0s): anon RPC -> 401 42501: permission denied for function sec21_fn; service_role RPC -> 200. The grantee that matters for functions is PUBLIC, not anon.

results.title: created afterwards: the table stays closed; the function reopens (per-schema default-privilege revoke cannot remove PUBLIC's EXECUTE)
results.detail: new table: anon -> 401 42501: permission denied for table sec21_new, service_role -> 200, 1 rows. New RPC: anon -> 200 - CALLABLE AGAIN: the IN SCHEMA public default-privilege revoke adds to the global default and cannot take away the built-in EXECUTE for PUBLIC.

results.title: global ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES ... REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS FROM PUBLIC: a new function is closed to anon
results.detail: after the global (no IN SCHEMA) revoke, a third new RPC: anon -> 401 42501: permission denied for function sec21_fn3; service_role -> 200. Default EXECUTE for PUBLIC is removed by the global entry only.

results.title: exposed schema = api only: service_role loses public until it sends Accept-Profile
results.detail: PATCH db_schema=api -> 200, effective after 3s. service_role GET public.sec21_pii -> 404 PGRST205: Could not find the table 'api.sec21_pii' in the schema cache; GET api.pii with Accept-Profile: api -> 200, 2 rows; GET pii with no profile header -> 200. The setting is project-wide: the backend's own calls move with it.

measurements.service_public_code: PGRST205: Could not find the table 'api.

results.detail: db_schema restored; grants and default privileges regranted to anon/authenticated and PUBLIC; fixtures and user removed
